title.rendered: Unequivocal Guide to Hire Dedicated Web Designers

content.rendered:
Entrepreneurs in different sectors from pharma to retail hire dedicated web designers to empower their business. It is impossible to imagine modern business without a website. And to beat the competitors on the Internet, your website should be more attractive, functional, fast-reacting, intuitive, than one of your competitors. Catching the attention of the potential client is the first task of the website. That’s why a decision to hire dedicated developers is so important for any business. A dedicated designer may be a part of the IT department in the organization or be employed directly by software providers, web design agencies, and IT consulting companies.

The specialists in web design create your website from scratch: work with design, layout, and programming. They are responsible for its appearance and functions: the coders will work with the graphical and technical aspects of the site. You may also need these specialists to update or maintain the existing website.

Why Do Companies Need to Hire Dedicated Website Designer

If users had only 15 minutes to browse websites, 66% of people would choose something with beautiful design, but not simple and plain. With such a high competition your content must be easy to consume and well-designed – only in this case, you will not lose your audience.

The design is important not only as a beautiful cover for the business – it is also a part of your marketing presence on the internet. After the establishing of the target audience and identifying the type of content, you will place there, you can pass the project to a mobile website designer. The specialist will do the following:

  • write the code from scratch or adapt the existing graphic and software packages of your website to meet the needs of your company
  • test the website and search for possible technical problems
  • upload the ready site onto a server and register it with search engines so the users could easily find and browse it

Benefits of Hiring a Website Designer

Web design influences your audience greatly. Often it is the only reason for a person to visit your page. And if you are still not sure how extending your team with a dedicated team of UX/UI developers can enhance your business, here are 5 reasons to hire freelance designers:

Current Demand for Web Designers

Almost every business needs professional assistance and looks for a web designer for hire. It means this position is in high demand. For example, the US Bureau of Labor Statistics claims, that the employment rates of web developers and designers are expected to grow by 13% in the period from 2018 to 2028. And these rates are the highest among the occupations.

On the job-seeker portals, there are thousands of job openings: the companies search for UI UX designer hire. For example, on indeed.com you can find 17,060 jobs for web designers in the US. And on Glassdoor, there are more than 23,400 companies, looking for the professional in this field.

One of the first industries to use web design is e-commerce and retail. Online purchasing is growing and it means users need more attractive, functional and fast websites. And as soon as people tend to use mobile devices more, businesses hire UI UX designer to adjust their websites to the changing needs.

Among the other industries:

  1. Healthcare
  2. Education
  3. Hotels and restaurants
  4. Smart TV app development
  5. Event agencies
  6. Automotive industry
  7. Agriculture
  8. Food industry
  9. Service providers
  10. Constructors
  11. Manufacturing

Things to Consider When You Hire Dedicated Web Designers

If you want to catch the top-notch professional, you have to know the qualities and traits of an excellent worker in this field. It is a complex profession that has dozens of nuances and variables. We’ve picked the most important features for a true professional designer hire in 2020:

  • Solid understanding of multiple tools. It is not enough to be an expert in one tool or technology. To improve the design process, the developer may need more options: Sketch, Affinity Designer, Figma, and more.
  • Ability to create a mobile-friendly design. Most of users browse the internet from mobile devices. The coder should be able to make all pages work perfectly on any device, combining a perfect appearance with the functionality.
  • Ability to provide users with immaculate UX design. UI UX designer for hire should be able to provide users with perfect usability and functionality, as well as effortless navigation.
  • Web development skills. Designing a website requires deep knowledge of programming languages. HTML, CSS, and JavaScript are the basics here, but the other options are also possible.
  • Chatbot development. For better customer support, the live chat on the website is a must. It requires own space and should stand out from the rest of the content on the page.
  • Experience in content creation. Hiring web designer business owners often want a specialist able to take part in the content creation process. The ability to create multimedia content for the webpages is a big advantage.
  • Soft skills. If you need to extend the team with a web designer, this person should have communication, time management, problem-solving skills, to become a part of the company.
  • Education. For the work in a large company, it is important to hire UI/UX designer who has formal education in Computer Sciences. And for the professional growth coder should take some extra courses and training.

Dedicated UX/UI Designers Cost Comparison

Hiring a website designer, you don’t have to stick to the location. It is a type of work that can be easily done remotely and even overseas. So, the real things you should care about are the relevant skillset and experience of the candidate and the budget you can spend on the design.

The professional from a dedicated team of designers can have a different salary in different parts of the world:

  • The US – $73,857 per year
  • The UK – £31,597, which is about $40,854 per year
  • Canada – C$62,369, which is about $46,586 per year
  • Germany – €40,204, which is about $44,043 per year
  • Ukraine – $26,859 per year

But business owners hire dedicated mobile UI UX designers from Ukraine not only because of the lower price. Other benefits of hiring professionals from Ukraine:

  • Promising market. Ukraine has a vast pool of talented designers, developers, and other IT specialists. Big European and American enterprises are investing in the IT industry here. And the specialists are doing their best to show the perfect results.
  • High quality. To get the best positions on the international labor market, Ukrainian programmers provide clients with software and websites of the highest quality and take part in international projects.
  • High activity of IT life. The IT sphere in Ukraine is very popular. All the specialists try to improve their skills and stay in touch with the newest technologies.
